capabilities: open floating sticky-note windows from the ribbon, command palette, or file context menu
pin notes on top and adjust window size and transparency
set background and text colors from a palette
restore open sticky notes with position, size, and appearance
save sticky note appearance to note frontmatter
extras: Desktop only (uses Electron APIs); requires Obsidian 1.13.0+ for the declarative settings API; relies on Obsidian popout/header DOM structure that may change in future versions; not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no floating sticky-note windows for keeping small notes visible on top of the workspace while working.
summary: Floating sticky-note windows for Obsidian with pin-on-top, color and transparency options, and restore of open notes across sessions.
